Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_memory_and_stt.py covering memory CRUD, manual/forget chat triggers, prompt injection, auto-extraction background task, and Whisper TTS→STT round-trip. Frontend: Login (serkan/19071987) works, 4-tab sidebar (GEÇMİŞ/GÖREVLER/HAFIZA/NOTLAR) renders correctly with new Brain icon tab, MemoryPanel CRUD (add/edit/delete/bulk-delete/filter chips) all functional, manual 'Bunu hatırla:' + 'unut' triggers verified through the actual chat UI (Sertex responded 'Tamam efendim, hafızama kaydettim' and 'ile ilgili 1 hafıza kaydını sildim' in Turkish), send-button + Enter both submit correctly. critical_code_review_comments: memory_service.list_memories does three sort() calls back-to-back (lines 262-264); only the last sort takes effect. Consider replacing with a single sort key tuple: docs.sort(key=lambda d:(-(d.get('importance') or 0), d.get('updated_at') or ''), reverse=False). Not blocking — end result is close enough — but wasteful.

server.py near-duplicate check inside save_memory pulls up to 500 existing docs into memory on every write — will not scale beyond a few hundred memories per user. Recommend switching to a MongoDB text index or a smaller candidate set (top-N most recent).

Whisper /api/stt/whisper: no size validation on multipart before reading into memory (transcribe_audio checks 25MB but only after audio.read() completes). Consider streaming or Content-Length preflight to reject oversized uploads early.
seed_data_creation: Test data (TEST_* memories and 'UI test manual memory 42') created during runs was cleaned up at end of module and via post-test cleanup call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Faz 0 fully verified. Backend test module test_memory_and_stt.py is idempotent (module-scope memory wipe fixture).
